plugins.name: 渐开线齿轮
plugins.description: 渐开线直齿轮生成器：模数、齿数、压力角、齿宽、孔径与变位系数。生成可编辑的草图与特征。
plugins.descriptionOriginal: Involute spur gear generator: module, teeth, pressure angle, face width, bore and profile shift. Builds an editable sketch and features.

plugins.name: Gridfinity 收纳系统
plugins.description: Gridfinity 收纳盒（空心、省料或实心）、底板，以及按打印机尺寸或指定抽屉底板拆分的抽屉底板，支持整格、半格或自定义网格。Edit bin 可修改已生成的收纳盒，未改动的设置保持为 Keep。
plugins.descriptionOriginal: Gridfinity bins (hollow, eco or solid), baseplates, and drawer baseplates split to fit your printer or a picked drawer floor, on a full, half or custom grid. Edit bin changes a bin it made, keeping each setting left at Keep.

plugins.name: 木工柜体
plugins.description: 用板材制作柜体与家具：柜体生成器与切割清单。
plugins.descriptionOriginal: Cabinets and furniture in sheet goods: carcass generator and cut list.

plugins.name: 热熔螺母座
plugins.description: 在已有孔的圆形边缘生成热熔螺纹螺母的座孔。
plugins.descriptionOriginal: Create heat-set insert seats and embedded hex nut pockets in existing holes.

plugins.name: 轴承
plugins.description: 放置深沟球轴承与 CSK 单向离合器。
plugins.descriptionOriginal: Insert radial bearings and CSK one-way clutches.

plugins.name: 型材导轨
plugins.description: MISUMI 5 系列 T 型槽与 OpenBuilds V 型槽导轨，含槽螺母。可在点上放置定长构件，或沿草图直线生成独立导轨。
plugins.descriptionOriginal: MISUMI 5 series T-slot and OpenBuilds V-slot rails, with slot nuts. Place fixed-length components on points, or build independent rails along straight sketch lines.

plugins.name: 热熔螺母
plugins.description: 基于 CNC Kitchen 的热熔螺母规格。选择草图点或圆：每处生成螺母底孔及螺母本体。
plugins.descriptionOriginal: Based on CNC Kitchen's heat-set inserts. Pick sketch points or circles: each gets the hole for an insert, and the insert.

plugins.name: 六角螺母
plugins.description: 放置普通六角螺母或尼龙锁紧螺母，可选配防转沉孔与螺栓孔。选择草图点或圆，也可在原点放置一个独立螺母。
plugins.descriptionOriginal: Place plain hex nuts or nylon-insert lock nuts, with optional captive pockets and bolt holes. Pick sketch points or circles, or place a loose nut at the origin.

plugins.name: 螺钉
plugins.description: 基于 ISO 公制螺钉标准。选择已有孔位来安装螺钉，或选择草图点和圆生成螺钉及可选底孔。未选择任何对象时，在原点放置一枚螺钉。
plugins.descriptionOriginal: Based on the ISO metric screw standards. Pick an existing bore to seat a screw, or pick sketch points and circles for screws and optional holes. With nothing picked, one screw sits on the origin.

plugins.name: V 型轮
plugins.description: OpenBuilds V 型轮。选择草图点或圆：每处生成一个滚轮，可包含轴承与垫片。未选择任何对象时，在原点放置一个滚轮。
plugins.descriptionOriginal: OpenBuilds V-wheels. Pick sketch points or circles: each gets a wheel, with its bearings and shim if you want them. With nothing picked, one wheel sits on the origin.

plugins.name: 生成式设计引擎
plugins.description: 工程材料库（含来源卡片）、材料报告、带安全系数的平板件二维应力校核、板材优化器，以及圆杆支架（桁架）设计器。第三方插件，与 SolidCraft 官方无关。
plugins.descriptionOriginal: Engineering material library (sourced cards), material report, a 2D stress check of flat parts with safety factor, a plate optimiser and a round-bar bracket designer (truss). Third-party plugin, not affiliated with SolidCraft.

plugins.name: 自定义螺纹
plugins.description: 为 3D 打印生成光滑 B-rep 自定义螺纹，支持预设、间隙、多线导程与实时参数。
plugins.descriptionOriginal: Smooth B-rep custom threads for 3D printing with presets, clearances, multi-start leads & live parameters.

plugins.name: 木工榫卯
plugins.description: 板材之间的木工接合：榫卯、开槽、半搭接、木榫、指接、活动榫、嵌槽、斜接、企口、斜接榫、燕尾榫、螺钉与饼干榫。
plugins.descriptionOriginal: Woodworking joints between boards: mortise and tenon, grooves, half laps, dowels, box joints, loose tenons, housings, miters, tongue and groove, scarfs, dovetails, screws and biscuits.

plugins.name: 齿轮生成器
plugins.description: 在原点生成渐开线圆柱齿轮：使用普通草图与拉伸，设计文件无需插件即可打开。
plugins.descriptionOriginal: A SolidCraft plugin: parametric involute spur gear generator (wasm component per RFC 0002)

plugins.name: 蜂窝与六边形生成器
plugins.description: 在选定的草图区域内填充最多 250 个单元。按 Esc 结束当前工具，再按住 Shift 点击区域后打开蜂窝工具。
plugins.descriptionOriginal: Fill up to 250 cells across selected sketch regions. End the active tool with Esc and Shift-click regions before opening Honeycomb.

plugins.name: 等轴测制造图
plugins.description: 将当前设计中的每个实体投影为真实等轴测视图，用深度缓冲消除隐藏线，并输出带尺寸的 ANSI B 制造图 SVG：标题栏、物料清单、参数表与注释。
plugins.descriptionOriginal: Projects every body of the open design to a true isometric, removes hidden lines with a depth buffer, and writes a dimensioned ANSI B manufacture sheet as SVG: title block, bill of materials, parameter table, notes and overall dimensions.

plugins.name: 模具生成器
plugins.description: 按打印机尺寸生成可打印模具。圆形：碗、花盆。方形：平面零件的模具。硅胶套：芯模、对开外套与底座。大型圆模需运行两次：若只生成外壳，请再次运行。
plugins.descriptionOriginal: Printed moulds sized to your printer. Round: bowls, planters. Box: flat-sided parts. Silicone sleeve: plug, split sleeve and base for a silicone liner. Big round moulds take two runs: if only the jacket appears, run again.

plugins.name: 3D 打印孔
plugins.description: 专为 3D 打印设计的孔。水滴形：选择草图圆后运行，每个孔上方会生成直径百分之几的小尖顶，防止水平孔顶部下垂。未选择对象时会绘制一个示例孔。
plugins.descriptionOriginal: Holes made for 3D printing. Teardrop: select sketch circles and run it; each gets a small tip a few percent of the diameter above it, so the top of a horizontal hole does not sag. Nothing selected: it draws an example hole.

plugins.name: AprilCube
plugins.description: 生成带 AprilTag 或 ArUco 标记、边缘倒角、镶嵌凹槽及检测器 JSON 的可打印立方体与体素靶标。
plugins.descriptionOriginal: Generate printable cuboids and voxel targets with AprilTag or ArUco markers, edge chamfers, inlay recess and detector JSON.

plugins.name: EasyPDM
plugins.description: Upload designs to an EasyPDM server and download them, through the EasyPDM companion program.
plugins.descriptionOriginal: Upload designs to an EasyPDM server and download them, through the EasyPDM companion program.

plugins.name: 耗材色卡
plugins.description: 耗材样品片：以文字标注品牌、材料、颜色与温度，并通过薄台阶展示耗材的透光程度。
plugins.descriptionOriginal: Filament sample tiles: brand, material, colour and temperatures in text, and thin steps that show how see-through the filament is.

plugins.name: KiCad
plugins.description: Import PCBs and exchange board outlines, mechanical holes and footprint placements with KiCad.
plugins.descriptionOriginal: Import PCBs and exchange board outlines, mechanical holes and footprint placements with KiCad.

plugins.name: 网格实体化
plugins.description: 将破损的网格实体（孔洞、开放壳体、重叠）重建为单一水密、可打印的实体，并作为新实体添加。
plugins.descriptionOriginal: Rebuild a broken mesh body (holes, open shells, overlaps) as one watertight, printable solid. Adds the result as a new body.

plugins.name: openGrid
plugins.description: openGrid wall and desk boards on the 28 mm grid, Full or Lite, with screw holes and cut corners, as editable sketches and features.
plugins.descriptionOriginal: openGrid wall and desk boards on the 28 mm grid, Full or Lite, with screw holes and cut corners, as editable sketches and features.

plugins.name: 螺纹生成器
plugins.description: 在选定面上切削带打印间隙的螺纹，或生成螺栓、螺母与螺柱的 STL。
plugins.descriptionOriginal: Cut a 3D-printable thread into a shaft or hole. Select its round face in the design, then Run. Hover a field for what it does. The thread is an editable feature in the timeline; one Ctrl+Z takes the whole run back.

plugins.name: 发送到 MakeOrbit CNC Studio
plugins.description: 将设计以 STEP 格式发送到 MakeOrbit CNC Studio（在对方程序中确认接收）。
plugins.descriptionOriginal: Konstruktion als STEP an MakeOrbit CNC Studio übergeben (Übernahme dort mit Nachfrage) · Send the design as STEP to MakeOrbit CNC Studio

plugins.name: 发送到 MakeOrbit
plugins.description: 将设计连同源文件以 STEP/STL/3MF 格式发送到 MakeOrbit（在对方程序中确认归档）。
plugins.descriptionOriginal: Konstruktion als STEP/STL/3MF mit Quellstand an MakeOrbit übergeben (Archivierung dort mit Nachfrage) · Send STEP/STL/3MF with the design to MakeOrbit

plugins.name: Gridfinity
plugins.description: Gridfinity bins and baseplates from a grid size: feet, stacking lip, magnet holes, dividers, scoop and label tab, as editable sketches and extrudes.
plugins.descriptionOriginal: Gridfinity bins and baseplates from a grid size: feet, stacking lip, magnet holes, dividers, scoop and label tab, as editable sketches and extrudes.

plugins.descriptionOriginal: SolidCraft plugin: JIS bolts and machine screws (10 head types, M3-M20) with modelled threads

plugins.name: 激光切割接合
plugins.description: 在激光切割板材的边缘生成指接榫与开槽。切缝与过盈保持为参数，特征位于时间轴中。
plugins.descriptionOriginal: Fingerzinken und Schlitze an Kanten von Laserplatten. Kerf und Pressung bleiben Parameter, die Features liegen in der Timeline.

plugins.name: SolidWorks 零件 (sw2sc)
plugins.description: 打开 SolidWorks 零件并保留其特征树：草图、尺寸、约束与特征，并依据零件自身实体进行校验。
plugins.descriptionOriginal: Opens SolidWorks parts with their feature tree: sketches, dimensions, constraints and features, checked against the part's own solid.

plugins.name: 木材型材
plugins.description: 标准木方截面（4x2、3x2、2x2、CLS、搁栅、立柱、木条），长度任意，可放置在原点，或与选定木方平行或垂直。
plugins.descriptionOriginal: Standard timber sections (4x2, 3x2, 2x2, CLS, joists, posts, battens) at any length, placed on the origin or parallel or at 90 degrees to a selected timber.
